title: Three Weeks and One Short Tape
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：length　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 length 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the tailor ① took the length that no customer in the store would have recorded, and he said the taking was the whole of the week. The ② length, meaning the measure itself and not the tape, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; a length, he said, is the only thing in a store that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ length in that store had the same short tape beside it, and the ④ length at the far counter, meaning the hem they kept for the children to turn and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A length, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the tailor said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the length was the whole of the matter, meaning the patience and not the measure. The ⑥ length, meaning the patience and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; length, he said, is either something you take or the only word that means both a measure and a patience. He said the patience is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ length had become a line in an order, and the order had become an argument about the short tape. The ⑧ length of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in May, was one store and three weeks of recording; length, he said, is either the hem at the far counter or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ length I remember is the measure recorded in the order, which closed in 1974 and is still recorded as the quietest in the store. A ⑩ length, my mother said in 1976, is the only measure that improves by being recorded; every length, she said, is a patience that has agreed to look like a measure. She said the patience was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 长度；长短（指裁缝铺里每一段旁边的那一段）
B. n. 长度；长短（指那段长度本身，与尺带相对）
C. 固定搭配：take the length 量取这一段长度
D. n. 长度；长短（指留给孩子们卷边的那一寸那一段）
E. n. 量裁之事（抽象总称，指一处裁缝铺的长度之事）
F. n. 长度；长短（指订单里写到、被记载的的那一段）
G. n. 耐心、分寸（指一件事里人人都量却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 分寸（抽象总称，指人人都量却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: took the length that no customer in the store would have recorded
The length, meaning the measure itself and not the tape
the length at the far counter
the length was the whole of the matter
the length had become a line in an order
The length of the whole thing
A length, my mother said in 1976

answers.why: take the length 意为“量取这一段长度”，1967 年那位裁缝把裁缝铺里没有一位顾客肯记载的一段长度做了一遍。
length 意为“长度；长短”，指那段长度本身而不是尺带，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。
length 意为“长度；长短”，指裁缝铺里每一段旁边的那一段，每一段旁边都有同一卷窄窄的尺带。
length 意为“长度；长短”，指最远那张案台留给孩子们卷边的那一寸那一段，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
length 意为“耐心、分寸”，指一件事里人人都量却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份耐心就是那件事的全部。
length 意为“分寸”，指人人都量却无人提起的那样东西而不是那段长度，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
length 意为“长度；长短”，指订单里写到、被记载的的那一段，到 1972 年这一段成了订单里的一行。
length 意为“量裁之事”，裁缝五月写道，整件事的长度之事是一处裁缝铺和三个星期的记载。
length 意为“长度；长短”，我记得的是订单里记载过的那一段，1974 年量准了，至今仍被说成裁缝铺里最安静的一段。
length 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，长度是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的长度。
